name: Scaphoid Fracture
definition: Fracture of the scaphoid, commonly after a fall on an outstretched hand, with risk of nonunion and avascular necrosis due to limited blood supply.

investigations.principle: Initial radiographs can be negative despite fracture.
investigations.MRI: MRI or CT is appropriate when clinical suspicion remains after negative radiographs.

green: Immobilize suspected fracture pending definitive assessment
amber: Displaced, proximal-pole or unstable fractures may require fixation.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Manibandha-bhagna principles may complement recovery only after modern fracture assessment.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of the scaphoid, commonly after a fall on an outstretched hand, with risk of nonunion and avascular necrosis due to limited blood supply.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
